title: スプリングSの後に・スピード勝ち

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite having difficulties with the distance, she secures victory. Sakura Bakushin O has newfound confidence to try for the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, believing her speed would better shine at the Aoi Stakes, I manage to talk her down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Emotional at hearing me long for even greater speed, Sakura Bakushin O is firm in making the Aoi Stakes her next goal.
